GUEST EXPERIENCES

What Customers Have To Say

Real reviews from international and domestic guests who stayed at Grand Addis Hotel.

“Exceptional hospitality and prime location”

We arrived early and could not check in immediately due to high occupancy, but the reception staff warmly welcomed us with fresh coffee, took care of our luggage, and allowed us to relax in the lounge. The Deluxe room was spotless, peaceful, and the bed exceptionally comfortable. We will definitely return!

Alexander WrightLondon, United Kingdom
Deluxe Room

“True gem in the heart of Addis Ababa”

Grand Addis Hotel exceeded all my expectations. The staff are so courteous, always greeting with genuine smiles. The restaurant serves incredible Ethiopian food alongside international dishes. Highly recommended for both business and leisure.

Bethelhem TadesseNairobi, Kenya
Grand Executive Suite

“Unbeatable value and peaceful oasis”

Traveling for diplomatic meetings, I needed reliable high-speed internet and quiet nights. The Standard Room delivered on every level. Quiet AC, modern bathroom, and 10 minutes to Bole Airport. Outstanding value!

Jean-Pierre LaurentParis, France
Standard Room

“Memorable stay for our anniversary”

From the warm welcome upon arrival to the authentic Ethiopian coffee tasting, everything was flawless. The location in 22 around Golagul made it so easy to get everywhere in the city.

Sarah & Michael JenkinsToronto, Canada
